race.description: Mangrove Mountain Memorial Club & Golf Course Town Plate Hcp (Bm64)
race.comment: POWERFUL PRAYER (6) strung together some good performances before his tough win last start in a Class 1 over 2200m at Nowra. Very fit gelding who is a key runner once again. SATONO'S SHOUT (8) gave up an early lead then came again to finish second to CAN'T RECALL ONE over this course and distance 17 days ago. Gets a 2kgs weight swing today which might be enough to turn the tables. SONIC BENDER (4) brings decent 2400m city form to the table, the pick of his recent efforts a close fourth in a BM72 at Rosehill two back. Winning chance on that form. DOLCE DIOR (2) battled on well to finish fourth behind CAN'T RECALL ONE here recently. Should be peaking now after four runs back. CAN'T RECALL ONE (1) defeated some key rivals here last time out but is getting up in the weights.
